content: The Chi Square Calculator is a tool designed for performing chi-square calculations using a 2x2 contingency table. The file provided contains the necessary structure for this calculation. To use the Chi Square Calculator, follow these steps: 1. Click on the provided link to download the spreadsheet. 2. In the designated white boxes within the spreadsheet, input the number of individuals corresponding to each group. 3. Optionally, you can also input the names of the groups (rows) and the categories (columns) for better clarity and organization.
